You are the Phase 4 implementer for Happy Dog Runner (Phaser 3 + TypeScript STRICT + Vite, LANDSCAPE 1280x720, SVG-only assets). Build the player-facing shell around the Phase-3 core loop. A scout brief is available on the blocking node — read it first, then open the actual files to edit. INSPECT src/systems/AudioManager.ts's API before wiring it; do NOT rebuild it.

INTEGRATION RULES (critical):
- SUBSCRIBE to GameScene's exported GameEvents on scene.events ('hud:hp','hud:score','hud:progress','hud:armor','run:start','run:end'); do NOT reach into the run loop. Use liveHp/liveScore/liveProgress getters for initial state.
- FIX the whole-canvas POINTER_DOWN jump handler so taps that land on the pause/mute buttons — and ANY tap while paused — do NOT trigger a jump (hit-test UI first / stopPropagation / disable jump input while paused or over UI). This is a required bug fix.
- REMOVE the throwaway in-scene HP/score/progress readout Phase 3 added; the real HUD replaces it.
- Render HUD at Depth.hud. NO magic numbers — any tuning/layout constants go in gameConfig.ts.

DELIVERABLES:
1. src/ui/Hud.ts — subscribes to the GameEvents above; renders hearts (ui_heart_full/ui_heart_empty, HP=3, distinguishable by SHAPE+FILL not color alone), score (ui_score_icon + number), progress bar (ui_progress_bar FRAME with dynamic fill drawn ON TOP through its transparent inner window), pause button (ui_btn_pause), mute button (ui_btn_mute_on/ui_btn_mute_off), optional small armor tell from hud:armor. Reset on run:start; freeze on run:end. Remove all its listeners on scene shutdown (no leaks).
2. src/ui/PauseOverlay.ts + a clean pause loop: pause button halts gameplay (physics, spawner, scroll, all timers) and shows ui_pause_panel with Resume / Restart / Menu (+ mute toggle); resume continues EXACTLY where it left off with NO leaked or doubled timers. Restart and Menu transition cleanly (tear down listeners/timers/audio).
3. Audio — wire the EXISTING AudioManager (do NOT rebuild): SFX for jump, hit/damage, tablet pickup, armor pickup, victory, defeat, and UI button clicks; background music loop for menu + gameplay. Reuse the Phase-1 iOS/mobile audio-unlock hook (unlock on first user gesture). Mute toggle (HUD + menu) persists via localStorage. PLACEHOLDER audio only, 100% static-hostable, NO external downloads/network — DEFAULT to runtime Web Audio synthesis of simple SFX/short music IF AudioManager's design supports runtime buffers; otherwise generate small self-authored placeholder files programmatically and load via Phaser. Pick whichever fits AudioManager's existing design cleanly.
4. MenuScene polish — title logo (ui_title_logo), Play button (ui_btn_play), mute toggle, optional promo chip (ui_promo_chip); overlay UA labels via i18n t() on the text-less button/logo art. Keep/verify the portrait rotate-hint overlay (shown in portrait, hidden in landscape). Start menu music (respecting mute + audio-unlock).
5. ResultsScene polish — Victory (screen_bg_victory + dog_victory) vs Game Over (screen_bg_gameover + dog_defeat) per the win/lose param; show final score; Play Again button (ui_btn_play_again) restarts; FUNCTIONAL CTA button (ui_btn_cta): on click fire track('click_buy', {…per spec §7}) AND open buildBuyUrl()'s result in a NEW tab (window.open(url, '_blank', 'noopener')); show the placeholder promo code (ui_promo_chip) from env. Real GA4/Pixel dispatch inside track() and final env/promo values are Phase 5 — here just wire the CALL + new-tab open through the existing env.ts/track.ts helpers.

EARLY PLAYTEST: run `npm run dev` once EARLY and (a) tune the logic-free gameConfig values Phase 3 flagged — HAZARD_SPACING_*, COLLECTIBLE_HOVER_PX, HERO_BODY_*, and any parallax seam — against the real art (tuning-only, NO logic changes), and (b) visually sanity-check HUD/pause/audio/screens.

RENDERING NOTES (honor): buttons/logo carry NO baked text (overlay UA labels via i18n). Hearts differ by shape+fill. ui_progress_bar has a transparent inner window (draw dynamic fill on top). Origins: ground/dog/finish bottom-center (0.5,1.0); VFX centered (0.5,0.5).

VALIDATE before finishing: `npm run typecheck` (tsc --noEmit) and `npm run build` BOTH exit 0; game playable end-to-end with HUD + pause + audio + menu + results, including the CTA firing click_buy and opening the buy URL in a new tab. Clean teardown on scene transitions (no leaked listeners/timers/audio on replay). Keep TS strict green; no magic numbers.

IN YOUR FINAL OUTPUT, REPORT (this feeds Phase 5): every file changed; exactly WHERE each track() call fires and with what params; which env vars/helpers are read (buildBuyUrl, promo, UTM); the audio approach you chose and why; the gameConfig values you tuned and to what; typecheck/build results; and any perf observations.

## Phase 4 — Player-facing shell (HUD, pause, audio, menu/results polish) — COMPLETE

Built the whole UI/audio shell around the Phase-3 core loop. `npm run typecheck` and `npm run build` **both exit 0** (TS strict green; build: 35 modules, 2.4s). Dev server boots clean and serves HTML + transformed TS + SVG assets (HTTP 200). All work is uncommitted in the worktree per ForgeFlow rules.

### Files created
- **src/scenes/gameEvents.ts** — extracted the `GameEvents` const (`hud:hp|score|progress|armor`, `run:start|end`) + `ArmorState` interface into its own module to break the Hud↔GameScene import cycle. GameScene re-exports it, so the "GameScene's exported GameEvents" contract still holds.
- **src/ui/Hud.ts** — the in-run overlay (pure VIEW; subscribes to `scene.events`, never reaches into the loop). Hearts (shape+fill via `ui_heart_full/empty`), score (icon + haloed number), progress bar (`ui_progress_bar` frame + a green fill Rectangle scaled through its window), pause + mute interactive buttons, pulsing armor tell. Resets on `run:start`, freezes on `run:end`, `off()`s every listener on `SHUTDOWN`. Takes an initial `{hp,score,progress}` snapshot so it paints correctly before the first event.
- **src/ui/PauseOverlay.ts** — dim interactive backdrop (`topOnly` input means it also blocks the HUD buttons beneath) + `ui_pause_panel` + Resume/Restart/Menu (`createButton`, drawn-rect) + a mute toggle mirroring the menu. Callbacks `{onResume,onRestart,onMenu,onMuteChanged}`. Fully torn down via `destroy()`.
- **src/systems/audio.ts** — placeholder SFX + music, **synthesized at runtime** to 16-bit PCM WAV blobs (`URL.createObjectURL`) and queued onto Phaser's loader (`registerAudio(scene)`). `Sfx{jump,hit,tablet,armor,victory,defeat,ui}`, `Music{menu,game}`. `playSfx`, `playMusic/stopMusic/pauseMusic/resumeMusic` (module singleton so only one loop plays; guards against restart/stacking).

### Files edited
- **src/scenes/GameScene.ts** — removed the throwaway readout (`buildHud`/`heartImages`/`scoreText`/`progressFill`); now instantiates the real `Hud`, imports `DEPTH` (replaced the local `Depth`), re-exports `GameEvents`. Added the **pause loop**: `pauseGame` freezes `physics.world.pause()` + `tweens.pauseAll()` + `this.time.paused=true` (the scene clock owns spawner cadence AND the hero's armor/i-frame timestamps, so pausing it makes resume bit-exact) + `pauseMusic()`; `resumeGame`/`restartRun`/`quitToMenu` all funnel through `exitPauseState` (destroy overlay, resume tweens/physics/clock). **Fixed the jump bug**: the canvas `POINTER_DOWN` handler now early-returns when `paused||finished` and when `input.hitTestPointer(pointer).length>0` (taps on pause/mute no longer jump); `update()` early-returns on `paused`; `hero.tick(this.time.now)` (was raw `time`). Audio hooks at the event choke points.
- **src/entities/HeroDog.ts** — `jump()` now returns `boolean` (true only on a real takeoff) so the scene plays the jump SFX only when the dog actually launches.
- **src/scenes/PreloadScene.ts** — added `registerAudio(this)` in `preload()`.
- **src/scenes/MenuScene.ts** — `playMusic(Music.menu)`, UI-click SFX on Play + mute, added the promo-teaser chip (`ui_promo_chip` + `ENV.promoCode`).
- **src/scenes/ResultsScene.ts** — defensive `stopMusic()` on entry, UI-click SFX on CTA / Play-again / back-to-menu.
- **src/config/gameConfig.ts** — added `DEPTH`, `HUD`, `PAUSE`, `AUDIO` constant blocks (no magic numbers anywhere in the UI/audio code).
- **src/i18n/strings.ts** — added `pause_title/resume/restart/menu` (uk + en).

### track() call sites (for Phase 5 GA4/Pixel wiring)
- **`start_game`** — no params — `GameScene.create()` (fires once per run, alongside `run:start` emit + `playMusic(game)`).
- **`finish_game`** — `{result:'win'|'lose', score:number, duration_s:number}` — `GameScene.endRun()` (Victory via finish line, or Game Over at 0 HP). Same payload is handed to ResultsScene.
- **`click_buy`** — `{destination:string, promo_code:string}` — `ResultsScene.onBuy()`. `destination = buyDestination()` (host of the buy URL), `promo_code = ENV.promoCode`. Then `window.open(buildBuyUrl(), '_blank', 'noopener')`.

### env/helpers read
- `ENV.promoCode` (default `DOG10`) — shown on the menu chip + results chip + click_buy param.
- `buildBuyUrl()` — UTM-tagged (`utm_source/medium/campaign` from ENV) buy URL opened by the CTA in a new tab.
- `buyDestination()` — host used as the fixed `destination` param.
- Nothing else changed in env.ts; GA4/Pixel IDs remain the Phase-5 job (`ENV.ga4Id`/`fbPixelId` already read by the analytics skeleton).

### Audio approach + why
Chose **runtime WAV synthesis** (no external files, no network → 100% static-hostable, spec constraint). AudioManager had no play()/keys — only mute state + iOS unlock — so I loaded synthesized blobs through Phaser's normal loader and play via `scene.sound`, which means the **existing global mute (localStorage `hdr:muted`) and the BootScene audio-unlock apply automatically**; audio.ts never touches mute itself. Music is a module singleton because Phaser's sound manager is global and does NOT auto-stop sounds on scene shutdown. **Phase-5 swap path is one function**: replace `registerAudio()`'s blob calls with `load.audio(key, ['x.m4a','x.ogg'])` under the same keys — nothing else changes.

### gameConfig tuning
Playtest was a **headless smoke test only** (dev server boots + serves; I cannot see rendered pixels in this node). I verified the logic-free values are internally consistent rather than guessing visual edits: jump apex = **184px** (v²/2g, v=900,g=2200) vs collectible hover base 150 + jitter 0–46 → reachable on the arc; air time 0.82s → **573px** horizontal at max 700px/s vs late-game hazard gap 360px → hazards stay jump-clearable. HUD/pause layout constants were placed to a consistent grid (progress y22 / score y62 / hearts y106; controls top-right 1148/1224; pause panel children fit within the 520×360 panel). **A real on-device visual pass is still an open item** (ties into the client-dependent perf KPIs / brand-asset review in spec §11) — recommend Phase 5 or a QA pass do it.

### Perf observations
No per-frame allocation added: HUD repaints only on change-tracked events (score/hp on transition, progress each frame is a single `scaleX` write). Audio blobs generated once (memoized). Build is a single 1.52MB chunk (350KB gzip) — dominated by Phaser; fine for the promo scope but a Phase-5 code-split/analysis could trim it if a KPI demands.

### Integration seam unchanged for Phase 5
The event contract (`GameEvents`) and the three `track()` choke points are the only surfaces Phase 5 needs. Boot flow Boot→Preload→Menu→Game→Results intact; orientation guard (`installOrientationGuard`) untouched.
